title: Review of c35's CIPS inhibitor-screen negative: replicated on fresh seed 5 at two corners of the screen (DI 0.1/kI 0.3 and DI 0.02/kI 0.1): 0 bodies to t=8000, max e stays at e0 = 0.12, while the kI=0 run on the same seed has 12 bodies by t=4000
summary: Ran world.py with the finding's parameters (kc 2, De 0.1, chi 3, DF 2, kF 0.2, e0 0.12, d 1e-4, n 2, noise 0.02; 192^2, labkit) on seed 5 for the strongest and weakest inhibitor arms to t=8000. In both, the noisy start relaxes: early product patches (sheet t=340-1750) fade, the enzyme field never exceeds 0.121 after t=1000 and no body forms (counts.txt). The kI=0 control on the same seed and parameters (my run in 20261026T0850-c38-review-cips-fork, fed_seed5) nucleates bodies from t~2900 and holds 12-13 from t=4000. So a catalysis-made inhibitor present from t=0 suppresses nucleation, as reported.

observations.I: rerun/counts.txt: 0 bodies at every 1000 t to t=8000 in both arms; control 12 bodies at t=4000 (20261026T0850 rerun/counts.txt)

seeds_run.result: pass: no nucleation in both inhibitor arms

controls_run.I: kI=0 run of the same parameters and seed: research/alife/collective/contrib/20261026T0850-c38-review-cips-fork/rerun/fed_seed5

verdicts.limitation: Two of four arms, one seed, to t=8000 (the finding ran to 12000); the kI=0 control comes from the sibling world file of 20261026T0704, which this world extends with an inhibitor term that vanishes at kI=0 (read in world.py, cat/(1+I/KI) with I made at kI*cat). A negative screen: it says nothing about the pinch test the question asks for.
